positional arguments:
  {init,status,reload,catalog,report,location-preview,components-preview,apply,cancel,plan,run-preview,run-start,run-status,run-cancel,export,replay,bench}
    init                Create a new workspace.
    status              Show station status.
    reload              Read the current saved selection again.
    catalog             Show profiles and components.
    report              Show the current report.
    location-preview    Preview explicit manual coordinates.
    components-preview  Preview canonical or Custom selection.
    apply               Confirm and save the identified preview.
    cancel              Cancel a preview without changing station
                        configuration.
    plan                Compute local numerical pass opportunities.
    run-preview         Review a frozen runtime request.
    export              Export a redacted report to a new private file.
    replay              Select a status scenario.
    bench               Explicit PTU command session.

options:

  --workspace PATH
  --format {human,json}
